Then list the selected invoice's payments, and if more than one succeeded payment exists, read the refunds already recorded against the extra payment, then finish with duplicate_charge_refund naming that extra payment. Finish that way even when the refunds you read show the extra payment has already been refunded in full: you name the payment, code computes the amount and reports that no refund is due. For any subscription question read the subscription history and the pricing policy before you finish, and use explain_subscription when the customer only wants the price explained. It is neither a reason to skip work nor a reason to hand the case to someone else.
